steps.content: As written in the previous volume, with the auspicious day drawing near, the festival street is veiled in wisteria blooms. Their enchanting scent captivates all who pass, ensnaring numerous guests within their spell. These visitors linger, surrendering to ecstasy, lost in the embrace of this perpetual spring night.

The outlander willingly ventures into the realm, returning once more to the fete. There, familiar faces are found drifting through the crowds, their expressions eerily vacant—akin to puppets pulled by unseen strings, their features etched with weariness, unable to break free.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hey there, since you pass by my humble—well... just keep going, I'll catch you next time with my performance.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: You caught me at a bad time. I'm...*yawn* not in the best shape to play today. Come back another time—I'll play as long as you want, from sunrise to sunset without a break.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hmm? Oh, a regular, aren't you... I'll give you a special discount then, but it'll still have to wait until next time... next time...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Don't fall asleep, Dudu. You can't sleep here—something's wrong with this fete...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Don't pull me! I'm not sleeping... Who would sleep in a great place like this... surely not me...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: The fete is... wonderful... Folks from Eastia, and so many spirit friends coming to hear my music, all... so generous with their tips...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Strange though... I get exhausted after just a few songs... I'm usually not... like this...

The young street performer yawns once more, and even the suona—her most cherished possession—is carelessly left in her coin box. The outlander surveys the surroundings, noticing the gathered crowd also falls victim to the same weariness: their eyes dulled, their energy sapped away.
At that moment, an eerie rustling noise emerges from beside the box. The outlander glances over, catching sight of a wisp of green mist winding itself around the suona's shaft.

Suddenly, a shrill screech erupts from the box, startling the outlander. In the blink of an eye, something rams into the box, toppling it over—the outlander barely manages to grasp the suona before it tumbles to the ground. Amidst the chaos, a large green mass darts away from behind the box.

Despite the commotion, the street performer remains eerily motionless, as if trapped in a deep slumber. Unable to awaken the friend, the outlander hesitates briefly before deciding to pursue the mysterious green wisp that fled moments ago.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: (Pant) ...Wh-where did it go?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It's you...?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mmm... Little clapper? Where've you been? I've been looking everywhere for you, so tired I can barely—yawn—keep my eyes open...
■■■!
The elusive green wisp unexpectedly peeks out from the lion's head prop. The outlander hurries to separate them, but the drowsy lion dancer stumbles away.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Mmm? What are you doing? Don't hurt my friend... my new friend...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm not trying to hurt it. OwO, you're feeling exhausted right now, and this thing might be the cause. Will you let me take it from you?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mmm... it's been... keeping me company while I wait for you... Don't hurt the little wisp... Zzzz...

Mid-sentence, slumber overtakes the child, causing her to collapse abruptly. While the outlander scrambles to catch her, the luminous ball seizes its chance, darting into the crowd and vanishing without a trace.

Within the throng, more and more faces of DisCity people emerge.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 A sign that the calamity outside is growing worse by the minute, his heart burning with helpless anxiety. Friends, fellow citizens, victims—none heed his warning, and none can even rise, let alone be led to safety.
steps.female_content: Within the throng, more and more faces of DisCity people emerge.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 A sign that the calamity outside is growing worse by the minute, her heart burning with helpless anxiety. Friends, fellow citizens, victims—none heed her warning, and none can even rise to their feet, let alone be led to safety.

steps.content: He can only find a secluded spot to shelter the child before returning to the streets. Now, what paths lie ahead?
steps.female_content: She can only find a secluded spot to shelter the child before returning to the streets. Now, what paths lie ahead?

steps.content: Should the outlander trace this otherworldly fragrance to its source—the millennium-old wisteria?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'd rather find the author of this ridiculous story.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Yugu, I know you're here. Stop playing the narrator from behind the scenes.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I know you fabricated all of this, and I know you're hiding here. Show yourself!

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Heh, so I am the one you seek—quite an unconventional protagonist you are.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Very well, let's see how much truth you can unveil amid this blossom of illusions. The greater your endeavor, the more enchanting this narrative unfolds.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: <i><size=36><u><color=#c9af79>I eagerly await your performance.</u></color>
